pages.text: Creative Forge makes Create's creative items craftable, through long automated chains that end in a $(l)mechanical crafter$() grid.
pages.title: Creative Forge

pages.text: The strongest items are $(l)capped per world$(): a server only ever gets a few creative crates, fluid tanks and motors. See $(l:creativeforge:rules/cap)How the Cap Works$(/l).$(br2)The chain: raw materials, then four components, then the $(l:creativeforge:components/singularity_core)Singularity Core$(/l), then a creative item.
